'''September 1999 St Albans tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St Albans, England on 26 September 1999. It is known from Mike Kessling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d53">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-27-st-albans-uk-9-26-99d53/ st-albans-uk-9-26-99], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 27 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-27-st-albans-uk-9-26-99d53/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 September 1999
* '''Site:''' St Albans, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
